message.content: On August 7th, 2026, Yuriko is seeking assistance from LiHua because she has ten logo designs for her speech therapy studio and needs feedback on which one stands out the most. Yuriko is excited for LiHua's opinion and asks for the designs to be sent over so she can begin reviewing them. LiHua agrees to look at the designs and expresses enthusiasm about helping Yuriko with her project.
